title: Network finds who matters to a thesis, why now, and whether someone else is already doing the work
summary: Intellectual Frontiers Network is the intelligence layer across the firm, with pages on how it works and a way to ask it a question.
text: Before the firm builds or funds anything, Network looks for the people and organizations who care about a thesis, what makes them care now, and whether a better-positioned team is already at work. The pages explain how the process runs and how to bring a question to it, and the hunts page lists what it is looking for.
